requirement: Desktop: a ChatGPT Codex sign-in finishes without pasting, whichever way the page opens it

oracle.invariant: The page asking the app to open the Codex authorize address (tracyDesktop.links.openExternal) starts the catcher, then opens the browser. A callback with the attempt's path and state gets a 200 HTML page, is delivered once as tracy-subscription-callback, and the catcher stops. A wrong state or another path gets a 404 and the catcher keeps listening; a busy port logs one line and leaves the paste path; the catcher stops after its time runs out; a second attempt replaces the first. The delivery script carries the URL as JSON data, whatever characters it holds.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
